question: Which among the following festivals is also known as Dala Puja devoted to worshiping the sun is traditionally celebrated by the people of Bihar?
solution:
The correct answer is __Chhath Puja__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Chhath Puja:

 
 
• Chhath is a Hindu festival dedicated to the Sun god and his wife Usha in order to thank them for bestowing the bounties of life on earth.
 
• The Goddess who is worshipped during the famous Chhath Puja is known as Chhathi Maiya (also known as Usha, wife of the sun god).
 
• The word Chhath means sixth and the festival is celebrated on the sixth day of the month Kartika of the Hindu lunar Vikram Samvat calendar.
 
• The festival is observed over a period of four days.
 
• The rituals include holy bathing, fasting, standing in water for long periods of time, and offering prayers and food to the setting and rising sun.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Bihula** is a festival celebrated in the month of Shravan by the people o**f Bihar and Jharkhand**.

 
 
• It is dedicated to the** snake goddess, Manasa Devi**.
 
 
 
• ** Madhushravani **is a festival celebrated in the month of **Shravan by the people of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.**
 
 
• It is dedicated to** Lord Shiva and the monsoon season.**
 
 
 
• **Sama Chakeva** is a festival celebrated by the** Mithila commun**ity in Bihar and Nepal.
 
 
• It is dedicated to the love between** a brother and a sister.**
